notes: Size 36 Performance 16 air conditioner outdoor unit, 208/230 V single phase, R-410A (Puron), from the 24ACC6 product data (catalog 24ACC6-8PD, 03/19), which covers sizes 18 to 60. Electrical and physical figures are the size 36 column; the fan motor, coil and cabinet wording comes from the guide specification for the whole range.

gaps: The product data does not name the compressor make or model; only the scroll type, RLA and LRA are claimed.
No capacitor or contactor is claimed: the data lists a hard-start capacitor and relay kit and a PTC start assist only as accessories.
No fan blade diameter is given.
Retail listings for other 24ACC6 sizes were seen in search results and not used: they are not Carrier documents for this model.
Catalog 24ACC6-8PD (03/19) is the only revision read; a later 10PD revision appeared in search results and was not compared.
method: Carrier Product Data, 24ACC6 Performance 16 Air Conditioner with Puron refrigerant, catalog 24ACC6-8PD, edition 03/19 (copyright line Carrier Corp.), read from a shareddocs.com copy.

PDF p.1 (features), p.2 (standard features and physical data), p.5 (accessories), p.8 (electrical data), p.9 (dimensions table naming 24ACC636A0030010), p.18 (guide specification), p.20 (copyright and catalog number).
Searches for a Carrier parts list for this model found no readable maker copy.

comps.spec: Scroll compressor, size 36, 208/230 V 60 Hz single phase: RLA 14.1 A, LRA 77.0 A. Internal thermal overload and internal pressure relief valve. Unit factory charge 6.75 lb (3.06 kg) of R-410A (Puron).
Condenser fan motor, 1/12 hp, 800 rpm, full load amps 0.50 (size 36). Guide specification for the range: totally enclosed, single phase, class B insulation, permanently lubricated bearings.
Direct-drive propeller fan, vertical discharge, 3,223 CFM at size 36. Statically and dynamically balanced.
Condenser coil of aluminum fins mechanically bonded to copper tubes. Size 36: 17.6 sq ft face area, 25 fins per inch, 1 row, 4 circuits. Valve connections 7/8 in vapor and 3/8 in liquid.
Maximum fuse or circuit breaker size 30 A for the size 36 unit (the data marks the fuse as time-delay); minimum circuit amps 18.1 A.
High-pressure switch and low-pressure switch, standard on size 36.
Unit cabinet of galvanized steel, louvered coil guard, and coated steel wire guards over the condenser fan openings.
